title: Lane-lint fails when merge --reviewed cannot parse the review record at the head
why: Two lanes tonight (#3052, #3050) reported review records posted, but runner 10's `merge --reviewed` parsed none at any head. Lanes hand in without checking that the record parses, and the batch runner finds out at merge.
source: coordinator 21:04 CST Nov 12 (2 of the last ~8 hand-ins)
note: Fix: lane-lint runs the same parser as `merge --reviewed` at the head and fails, naming the record, when it parses none. One home: call the merge tool's parser, never a copy. Red first on a record shaped like the #3052 or #3050 one. Started by coordinator 21:07 CST Nov 12. Sighting, coordinator 21:20 CST Nov 12 (#2682, now done with positive net value, re-handed express): `merge --review-record` for a round 3 on a guard or check change writes "Net value: not owed" when --net-value is not passed, and `merge --reviewed` then fails the record. Fix candidate: the writer refuses a round-3 record on a guard or check change without --net-value (one parser, so writer and reader agree). Second case, coordinator 21:21 CST Nov 12: #3014's record failed `merge --reviewed` because of hand-added text after the machine lines (re-posted at f8e7d7e53, now done, round 3 net value positive, re-handed to runner 10). Refuse trailing hand text at post time.
